summary: Expanded the AI/data-center power-load node into a focused underfollowed universe of scarce physical and regulated-grid enablers. The strongest Layer 1B discovery candidates are not hyperscalers or generation owners, but suppliers of transmission hardware, switchgear, metal coatings for grid/data-center infrastructure, and utility grid-edge software/data. These names plausibly benefit if AI data-center load growth forces faster procurement of interconnection equipment, substations, distribution gear, transmission upgrades, forecasting tools, and power-quality systems.
